# sce-c-tests — W3C SCXML conformance harness for the C11 backend
# (RFC §5.J.1, watching-zenoh consumer).
#
# Sibling of `tests/` (the C++ AOT/Interpreter harness). C11 code is
# generated by `sce-codegen -l c11` into ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/
# generated/, then linked together with the per-fixture runner in
# `aot_tests/test_<NUM>.c` to produce one CTest binary per fixture.
#
# Per-fixture runners are intentionally minimal — `int main(void)`
# returning 0 on PASS and 1 on FAIL — because the C11 backend cannot
# pull in GoogleTest the way the C++ harness does. CTest treats the
# binary's exit status as the verdict, which is enough for AOT-only
# conformance (no in-test fixtures, no parametrised cases).

include(${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/SCEStaticW3CTest.cmake)

set(SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}")

# Host-side support translation units for fixture binaries. Currently
# carries the POSIX `_sce_clock_now_ms` definition (W3C SCXML 6.2
# delayed-send clock binding); future runner-side helpers join here as
# additional fixtures force them. Linked uniformly into every C11 fixture
# below so any `<send delay>`-bearing fixture (safety-net or
# success-path) resolves the symbol without per-runner duplication; the
# linker dead-strips the object in fixtures whose generated code never
# references the symbol.
add_library(sce_c_test_support STATIC support/clock.c)
target_include_directories(sce_c_test_support PUBLIC
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/sce-c-runtime/include"
)
set_target_properties(sce_c_test_support PROPERTIES
    C_STANDARD 11
    C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
    C_EXTENSIONS OFF
)

# Host-side XML DOM helper for the W3C SCXML B.2 corpus (test557, test561).
# 1:1 algorithmic mirror of cpp `XMLDOMWrapper` + `LuaDOMBinding` re-
# implemented in pure C — pugixml is C++-only and would violate the C11
# backend's R3 zero-deps lock-in. Kept as a separate STATIC archive so
# only fixtures explicitly flagged NEEDS_DOM pull it (and the lua54 link
# it transitively requires); datamodel-less and Lua-only fixtures stay
# free of the DOM machinery.
add_library(sce_c_test_dom_support STATIC
    support/dom.c
    support/lua_dom_binding.c
)
target_link_libraries(sce_c_test_dom_support PUBLIC lua54)
target_include_directories(sce_c_test_dom_support PUBLIC
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/support"
)
set_target_properties(sce_c_test_dom_support PROPERTIES
    C_STANDARD 11
    C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
    C_EXTENSIONS OFF
)

# Host-side HTTP/1.1 client + JSON response extractor for the W3C SCXML
# C.2 BasicHTTPEventProcessor corpus (test201/509/510/513/518/520/522/
# 531/532/534/567). Synchronous POST against the existing Node.js
# `tests/w3c/standalone_http_server.js` (Pattern B-i, see RFC
# `claudedocs/rfc-c11-option-m-http.md` §3.2 — single source of truth
# already used by Go/Rust harnesses + cpp WASM lane). POSIX socket(2)
# only, no third-party dep — libcurl is too heavy for the host-helper
# R3 budget and cpp-httplib is C++ only. Separate STATIC archive so
# only fixtures flagged NEEDS_HTTP pull it; datamodel/DOM fixtures
# stay free of the network machinery.
add_library(sce_c_test_http_support STATIC
    support/http_client.c
    support/http_lua_binding.c
)
target_link_libraries(sce_c_test_http_support PUBLIC lua54)
target_include_directories(sce_c_test_http_support PUBLIC
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/support"
)
set_target_properties(sce_c_test_http_support PROPERTIES
    C_STANDARD 11
    C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
    C_EXTENSIONS OFF
)

# C11 fixture registry — extend as W3C category coverage grows.
# Each entry both (a) drives sce-codegen via the macro below and
# (b) lines up with `aot_tests/test_<NUM>.c` for the per-fixture runner.

set(W3C_C_AOT_TESTS_NEEDS_LUA "")
set(W3C_C_AOT_TESTS_NEEDS_DOM "")
set(W3C_C_AOT_TESTS_NEEDS_HTTP "")
set(W3C_C_AOT_TESTS_NEEDS_INVOKE "")

sce_generate_static_w3c_c_test(459 "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}" NEEDS_LUA)  # W3C SCXML 4.4: <log label="..." expr="..."> is observable side-effect only — pass / fail finals each carry an onentry log call that lowers to a `lua_eval_eventexpr` call (reused as the generic to-string helper) followed by `fprintf(stderr, "label: %s\n", buf)`; the boolean PASS path is independent of the log emit, so the new branch is verified by the C compiler's `-Werror` acceptance of the generated fprintf

sce_generate_static_w3c_c_test(186 "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}" NEEDS_LUA)  # W3C SCXML 5.10 + 6.2: delayed <send><param expr="Var1"/></send> snapshots Var1=1 at send time even though the surrounding onentry reassigns Var1=2 before the 1 s timer fires — luaL_ref anchors `_pending_donedata` in the registry across the scheduling gap so a subsequent immediate-send rebinding the global slot cannot clobber the captured payload; the _tick dispatch path restores the table onto _pending_donedata just before raising so set_current_event promotes it onto _event.data and the receiving transition reads aParam=1, routing to pass

sce_generate_static_w3c_c_test(205 "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}" NEEDS_LUA)  # W3C SCXML 5.10 + 6.2: two bare-external <send>s in doc order — first carries <param expr="1"/> on _pending_donedata, second is param-less; mainEventLoop dequeues event1 first (data promoted, slot reset to nil), then timeout dequeues with _event.data nil; the cond Var1==1 in s1 matches pass
sce_generate_static_w3c_c_test(560 "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}" NEEDS_LUA)  # W3C SCXML 5.10 + 6.2: <send event="foo"><param name="aParam" expr="1"/></send> without a top-level <datamodel> — the cond `_event.data.aParam == 1` is what forces needs_script_engine, the param-expr static literal 1 still routes through the lua promotion path so _event.data.aParam is the number 1 at the receiver
sce_generate_static_w3c_c_test(173 "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}" NEEDS_LUA)  # W3C SCXML 6.2: <send targetexpr> evaluates Var1 at send time (Var1 reassigned to '#_internal' before send) — runtime target buffer drives the codegen-time `#_internal` / `!`-prefix / unreachable dispatch arms; cpp `SendHelper::isInternalTarget`/`isInvalidTarget` are inlined as stack-buffer prefix checks (T3 lock-in)
sce_generate_static_w3c_c_test(174 "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}" NEEDS_LUA)  # W3C SCXML 6.2: <send typeexpr> evaluates Var1 at send time (Var1 = SCXMLEventProcessor URI) — supported-type literal compare mirrors cpp `SendHelper::isSupportedSendType`; eval failure falls back to the SCXMLEventProcessor default per cpp line 47, so the unbound initial Var1 still lands on pass via the bare-external dispatch
sce_generate_static_w3c_c_test(175 "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}" NEEDS_LUA)  # W3C SCXML 6.2: <send delayexpr> evaluates Var1 at send time and parses '1s' to 1000 ms via the new lua_eval_delayexpr macro — paired with a sibling literal-delay 0.5s send so event1 fires before event2 and the s0→s1→pass chain wins over the s0 wildcard fail; needs polling-driven _tick (test579 pattern)
sce_generate_static_w3c_c_test(183 "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}" NEEDS_LUA)  # W3C SCXML 6.2.4: <send event=event1 idlocation=Var1> auto-stores the parser-generated sendid (`__send_N`) into the lua datamodel variable Var1 — the cond `typeof Var1 !== 'undefined'` reads Var1 as the bound string and routes to pass

# W3C SCXML 3.13 separate <onentry>/<onexit> blocks — single axis batch
sce_generate_static_w3c_c_test(376 "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}" NEEDS_LUA)  # W3C SCXML 3.13: each `<onentry>` element is an independent execution block — block 1's `<send target="!invalid">` raises error.execution and stops subsequent actions in that block (W3C 5.10), but block 2's `<assign Var1=Var1+1>` still runs because block 2 is a separate block — Var1 reaches 2 → cond `Var1==2` routes s0→pass. The C11 mirror lifts each onentry block into its own static helper function (cpp's `EntryExitHelper::executeEntryBlocks` vector-of-lambdas dispatch, T3-inlined): a `return;` inside the helper terminates only that block, and the enclosing switch case sequentially calls the next helper.

# W3C SCXML 4.6 + 5.4 + B.2 foreach validation + shallow copy — single axis batch
sce_generate_static_w3c_c_test(457 "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}" NEEDS_LUA)  # W3C SCXML 4.6 + 5.4: `<foreach array=...>` requires the value to satisfy `instanceof Array`. s0's array=Var4 (number 7) fails the new `_isArray` runtime check (mirrors cpp `LuaEngine::_isArray` lua_pushcfunction at LuaEngine.cpp:463-483, T3-inlined as a Lua-script via dostring) → `_sce_n < 0` arm raises error.execution + `return;` (W3C 5.10 stop-subsequent-content; axis I block helper terminates only that block). s0→s1: array=Var5=[1,2,3] passes `_isArray` but item="'continue'" emits an illegal Lua identifier — `lua_foreach_body_iter` chunk fails on first iteration, raises error.execution and `break`s the C loop (body actions never executed → Var1 stays 0). s1→s2 verifies Var1==0 (executable content never ran), then s3 iterates [1,2,3] cleanly summing to Var6=6 → cond Var6==6 → pass.
sce_generate_static_w3c_c_test(460 "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}" NEEDS_LUA)  # W3C SCXML 4.6 + B.2 shallow copy: `<foreach array="Var1">` body executes `Var1 = [].concat(Var1, [4])` per iteration — the new `_concat` Lua helper (mirrors cpp `LuaEngine::_concat` at LuaEngine.cpp:519-539, T3-inlined as a Lua-script via dostring) creates a fresh table, leaving the foreach prologue's `_sce_foreach_arr` referencing the original [1,2,3] table by Lua's table-by-reference semantics. The iteration count therefore stays at 3 — Var2 reaches 3 → cond Var2==3 → pass; verifies the shallow-copy invariant emerges naturally from Lua reference binding without any explicit table-copy in the prologue.

Result: `var1 = (function(invar)  return invar + 1\n end)`, then `var1(2)` invokes natively and the cond `var1(2) == 3` matches.

Pins the per-SM `pending_invokes` queue + child SM struct embed + macrostep-end execute-pending hook + `_destroy` child cleanup walk. Children whose initial state is non-final (parent↔child send, finalize, autoforward) reach final asynchronously and require cross-SM event routing — extending the same emitter is the path forward.

# W3C SCXML 6.4.1 invoke — `<param>` / `namelist` value passing AND the cross-machine `<send target="#_parent">` plumbing the param tests rely on for verdict signalling. Each child reaches `<final>` only after firing an eventless transition whose body sends `success` / `failure` / `varBound` / `event1` to the invoking parent; the parent's auto-generated `<sm>_dispatch_external_by_name` shim converts the name to the parent's event enum (analyzer-promoted) and enqueues onto the external queue. Parent-side: `execute_pending_invokes` evaluates each `<param expr>` on its own lua_State and transfers the top-of-stack value to the child's lua_State via `lua_xfer_top_to_child`, gated per-name on `child_datamodel_vars` so undeclared namelist names (test245) silently drop. Child-side: `_init` skips the post-entry eventless loop when `has_parent_communication=true` so the parent has a chance to apply param/namelist overrides + stamp `parent_dispatch` before the child's first macrostep runs.
sce_generate_static_w3c_c_test(226 "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}" NEEDS_INVOKE NEEDS_LUA)  # W3C SCXML 6.4.1 (test226): `<param name="Var1" expr="1"/>` overrides the child's unbound `<data id="Var1"/>` default. Child's `conf:isBound="1"` cond fires → `<send target="#_parent" event="varBound"/>` → parent reaches pass.
sce_generate_static_w3c_c_test(240 "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}" NEEDS_INVOKE NEEDS_LUA)  # W3C SCXML 6.4.1 (test240): two-arm fixture exercising namelist (s01) AND `<param>` (s02) — both mechanisms must transfer Var1=1 from parent to child for the test to reach pass. First arm pins namelist transfer parity with cpp; second arm pins `<param expr>` evaluation in the parent's lua_State.
sce_generate_static_w3c_c_test(241 "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}" NEEDS_INVOKE NEEDS_LUA)  # W3C SCXML 6.4.1 (test241): three sequential invokes (s01 namelist, s02/s03 param) — both mechanisms must yield identical observable values in the child. Pins macrostep-end `execute_pending_invokes` cycling through multiple per-state invokes within the same parent's lifetime.
sce_generate_static_w3c_c_test(243 "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}" NEEDS_INVOKE NEEDS_LUA)  # W3C SCXML 6.4.1 (test243): single `<param>` value transfer — minimal counterpart to test240 isolating the param path from the namelist path.
sce_generate_static_w3c_c_test(244 "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}" NEEDS_INVOKE NEEDS_LUA)  # W3C SCXML 6.4.1 (test244): single `namelist` value transfer — minimal counterpart isolating the namelist path. Parent's Var1=1 must reach the child's Var1 via name lookup on `sm->L` (parent state) + push to `child.L`.
sce_generate_static_w3c_c_test(245 "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}" NEEDS_INVOKE NEEDS_LUA)  # W3C SCXML 6.4.1 (test245): namelist `Var2` references a name NOT declared in the child's datamodel — the codegen-time `child_datamodel_vars` membership check must skip the push so the child's Var2 stays unbound (Lua nil). Child's `conf:isBound="2"` then takes the default (false) arm → success → pass. If the filter were missing, Var2=3 would be pushed into the child, isBound=true, and failure would route to fail.
sce_generate_static_w3c_c_test(276 "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}" NEEDS_INVOKE NEEDS_LUA)  # W3C SCXML 6.4.1 (test276): `<param>` overrides the child's `<data id="Var1" expr="0">` initial-value default — verifies the post-`_init` overwrite ordering. The child's `_init` seeds Var1=0, the parent's transfer overwrites Var1=1 before the child's first `_step`, the child's `Var1==1` cond matches → `event1` → pass.

# W3C SCXML 6.4 invoke — `<onentry><send target="#_parent">` in the child runs during the child's `enter_state_recursive` walk inside its `_init`, so parent_dispatch must be live BEFORE the entry walk rather than stamped after it. The codegen now emits `_init_with_parent` (parent_sm + dispatch parameters) for every child SM with `has_parent_communication=true` and removes the plain `_init` symbol for those SMs — the only call site is the parent's `execute_pending_invokes` helper. Child SMs whose only `<send target="#_parent">` lives in transition bodies (test226/240/241/243/244/245/276) take the same code path and behave identically because the post-init macrostep loop still drives those sends.
sce_generate_static_w3c_c_test(191 "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}" NEEDS_INVOKE)  # W3C SCXML 6.4 (test191): minimal onentry `<send target="#_parent">` — child sub0 onentry sends `childToParent`, eventless transition enters subFinal. With parent_dispatch stamped before entry walk the send routes to the parent's external queue → s0→pass; without it the send drops, child reaches subFinal, done.invoke routes to `*` → fail. Pins the `_init_with_parent` ordering for the bare onentry-send shape.
sce_generate_static_w3c_c_test(338 "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}" NEEDS_INVOKE NEEDS_LUA)  # W3C SCXML 6.4 / 5.10.1 (test338): `<onentry>` of `<final id="sub0">` sends `event1` to `#_parent` (carrying the auto-generated invokeid). Parent captures `_event.invokeid` into Var2, compares against idlocation-bound Var1. Combines the onentry-stamp ordering with test228's invokeid plumbing — the send must reach the parent (live parent_dispatch during entry walk) AND carry the same id the parent stored at defer time.

# W3C SCXML 6.4 invoke — parent → child via `<send target="#_<invokeid>">`. Each invoke with an explicit `id="X"` exposes the embedded child's public `_raise_external_by_name` shim; the parent's send action codegen-resolves the `#_X` literal to the matching invoke at template time and emits a direct call. Combined with `_drive_active_children` (called from parent's `_step` after `execute_pending_invokes`), the dispatched event lands on the child's external queue and is drained on the same macrostep so the round-trip completes within the parent-side timeout.
sce_generate_static_w3c_c_test(192 "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}" NEEDS_INVOKE)  # W3C SCXML 6.4 (test192): explicit `<invoke id="invokedChild">` + parent's `<send target="#_invokedChild" event="parentToChild">` from s01→s02 transition body. Child's onentry dispatches `childToParent` to parent; on receiving `parentToChild` the child transitions to subFinal with `<send target="#_parent" event="eventReceived">` before raising `done.invoke`. The verdict event must arrive before `done.invoke → fail` to drive parent → s02 → pass. Pins both the codegen-time `#_<id>` resolution and the macrostep-end child driving (without it the parent → child message would sit in the child's queue undrained until the 5 s timeout fires).

# W3C SCXML 6.2 invoke — child SCXML carries `<send delay="...">` in its own session. Parser's `parse_child_metadata` walks the child for any delayed send and stamps `child_needs_event_scheduler` on the invoke; `_drive_active_children` calls the child's `_tick` (which promotes elapsed scheduled entries) instead of just `_step` when the flag is on.
sce_generate_static_w3c_c_test(207 "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}" NEEDS_INVOKE)  # W3C SCXML 6.2 (test207): child schedules `event1` (1 s, sendid=foo) and `event2` (1.5 s) then immediately notifies parent via `childToParent`. Parent's `<cancel sendid="foo">` runs in parent's session and MUST NOT touch the child's scheduler — child's `event1` fires at 1 s, drives sub0→subFinal with `<send target="#_parent" event="pass">`, parent reaches pass. Pins per-session scheduler isolation + child `_tick` driven from `_drive_active_children`.

# W3C SCXML 3.4 / 6.4 invoke completion ordering — natural-final children run a `_finalize_session` exit walk so a final state's `<onexit><send target="#_parent">` fires BEFORE `done.invoke`; cancel-path children (parent state-exit destroys the invoke) get `parent_dispatch = NULL` BEFORE `_destroy`, dropping any onexit-emitted sends per W3C cancellation-drop semantics. Both helpers are gated on `child_has_send_to_parent` so test247-shape pure-final children skip both paths.
sce_generate_static_w3c_c_test(236 "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}" NEEDS_INVOKE)  # W3C SCXML 3.4 / 6.4 (test236): child = pure top-level `<final>` with `<onexit><send target="#_parent" event="childToParent">`. `_finalize_session` runs subFinal's onexit BEFORE `done.invoke` so parent transitions s0→s1 on childToParent and then s1→s2 on done.invoke (with `done.invoke → fail` at s0 level only matching if it arrives first). Parent's 2 s timeout drives s2→pass.
sce_generate_static_w3c_c_test(252 "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}" NEEDS_INVOKE)  # W3C SCXML 6.4 (test252): parent's s01 onentry raises `foo`, the same macrostep transitions s01→s02 canceling the invoke. The cancel path NULLs the child's `parent_dispatch` before `_destroy`; child's `sub0 <onexit><send target="#_parent">` drops at the NULL guard. Parent's 1 s timeout fires unopposed → pass.
sce_generate_static_w3c_c_test(347 "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}" NEEDS_INVOKE)  # W3C SCXML C.1 (test347): both directions of `<send>` carry an explicit `type="http://www.w3.org/TR/scxml/#SCXMLEventProcessor"` — child→parent (#_parent) and parent→child (#_<invokeid>). The existing send-action `send_type` predicate already accepts this URI alongside the default-no-type form, so both lowers route normally. Verifies the explicit-type compatibility against the same paths test192/338 exercise without the type attribute.
sce_generate_static_w3c_c_test(253 "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}" NEEDS_INVOKE NEEDS_LUA)  # W3C SCXML 5.10.1 (test253): bidirectional `_event.origintype` round-trip. Child sends `childRunning` to `#_parent` → parent's s01 captures `_event.origintype` into Var1 (must equal the SCXMLEventProcessor URI). s02 cond `Var1 == URI` dispatches `parentToChild` via `#_foo` → child's sub1 captures `_event.origintype` into Var2, then the URI cond fires `<send target="#_parent" event="success">`. Parent reaches pass. Verifies that both the cross-machine routing paths (`#_parent` and `#_<id>`) go through external-queue raises so the URI-seeded origintype is the same on both sides.

# One CTest binary per fixture. Compiled with the C11 dialect explicitly so
# `_Static_assert` and stdint/stdbool are first-class regardless of the
# compiler's default standard. Lua54 is linked only into fixtures flagged
# NEEDS_LUA so datamodel-less fixtures preserve their MCU-relevant
# zero-deps profile.
foreach(TEST_NUM ${W3C_C_AOT_TESTS})
    set(_runner "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/aot_tests/test_${TEST_NUM}.c")
    set(_generated "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}/test${TEST_NUM}_sm.c")
    set(_target "sce_c_w3c_test_${TEST_NUM}")
    # W3C SCXML 6.4: per-test invoke child sources. Empty for fixtures that
    # carry no `<invoke>` (the variable is unset / empty list); fixtures
    # marked NEEDS_INVOKE see the sce-build-extracted
    # `__sce_synth_invoke__*_sm.c` translation units staged into the
    # binary so child SM types are linked into the parent's _sm.c.
    set(_child_sources "${W3C_C_AOT_TEST_${TEST_NUM}_CHILD_SOURCES}")

    add_executable(${_target} ${_runner} ${_generated} ${_child_sources})
    target_link_libraries(${_target} PRIVATE sce_c_runtime sce_c_test_support)
    target_include_directories(${_target} PRIVATE "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}")
    if(${TEST_NUM} IN_LIST W3C_C_AOT_TESTS_NEEDS_LUA)
        target_link_libraries(${_target} PRIVATE lua54)
    endif()
    if(${TEST_NUM} IN_LIST W3C_C_AOT_TESTS_NEEDS_DOM)
        target_link_libraries(${_target} PRIVATE sce_c_test_dom_support)
    endif()
    if(${TEST_NUM} IN_LIST W3C_C_AOT_TESTS_NEEDS_HTTP)
        target_link_libraries(${_target} PRIVATE sce_c_test_http_support)
    endif()
    set_target_properties(${_target} PROPERTIES
        C_STANDARD 11
        C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
        C_EXTENSIONS OFF
    )

    add_test(NAME w3c_c_aot_${TEST_NUM} COMMAND ${_target})
    set_tests_properties(w3c_c_aot_${TEST_NUM} PROPERTIES
        TIMEOUT 30
        LABELS "w3c;c11;aot"
    )
endforeach()

# ─── DOM helper unit tests ──────────────────────────────────────────
#
# Coverage for the full pugixml feature set (DOCTYPE / CDATA / entity
# decoding / mixed text PCDATA) that the W3C SCXML B.2 corpus does not
# force. Without these the additions to sce-c-tests/support/dom.c are
# unconsumed; the unit suite is the first reader and pins the parser's
# `parse_default`-equivalent behaviour against drift.
add_executable(sce_c_dom_unit_test unit/dom_test.c)
target_link_libraries(sce_c_dom_unit_test PRIVATE sce_c_test_dom_support)
target_include_directories(sce_c_dom_unit_test PRIVATE
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/support"
)
set_target_properties(sce_c_dom_unit_test PROPERTIES
    C_STANDARD 11
    C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
    C_EXTENSIONS OFF
)
add_test(NAME c11_unit_dom COMMAND sce_c_dom_unit_test)
set_tests_properties(c11_unit_dom PROPERTIES
    TIMEOUT 10
    LABELS "unit;c11"
)

# ─── HTTP client unit tests ────────────────────────────────────────
#
# Coverage for the host-side HTTP/1.1 client + JSON response extractor
# (sce-c-tests/support/http_client.{c,h}). The W3C SCXML C.2 corpus
# only exercises the happy path against the standalone Node server;
# these unit tests force edge cases the corpus does not (URL parsing
# rejections, percent-encoding overflow, depth-counted JSON object
# capture with embedded `}`, `\uXXXX` UTF-8 unescape) plus a single
# end-to-end POST round-trip against an in-process loopback server
# (TCP 127.0.0.1, OS-assigned port, single-shot accept thread). pthread
# link is local to this binary — sce_c_test_http_support stays free of
# threading deps so fixture binaries that only call the synchronous
# POST API do not pull pthread either.
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
add_executable(sce_c_http_client_unit_test unit/http_client_test.c)
target_link_libraries(sce_c_http_client_unit_test
    PRIVATE
        sce_c_test_http_support
        Threads::Threads
)
target_include_directories(sce_c_http_client_unit_test PRIVATE
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/support"
)
set_target_properties(sce_c_http_client_unit_test PROPERTIES
    C_STANDARD 11
    C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
    C_EXTENSIONS OFF
)
add_test(NAME c11_unit_http_client COMMAND sce_c_http_client_unit_test)
set_tests_properties(c11_unit_http_client PROPERTIES
    TIMEOUT 10
    LABELS "unit;c11"
)
